args.text:
Principles (A02):
1. Each game starts fresh; play sound, principled chess. Avoid blunders first, then seek small advantages.
2. Check every move for hanging pieces, forks, pins, and back-rank threats (both sides) before moving.
3. Develop quickly, castle early, control the centre, connect rooks.
4. Prefer solid structures; avoid premature pawn storms unless the attack is concrete.
5. In equal endgames, activate the king and push passed pawns carefully.
6. When ahead, simplify and trade pieces; when behind, keep pieces on and create complications.
7. Draws are worth half a point: accept only clearly equal, dead-drawn positions; play on when the opponent errs.
8. Resign only when lost with no practical chances.
9. Verify the board with viewBoard before each move; track whose colour I play.
